699a80908991ef784965077b description: You have been operating quietly: no noise, no unnecessary bodies, no attention. Not many manage that in Tarkov. Fewer still get noticed for it. There is a man watching the movement of supplies across the region. Not a trader in the usual sense, more of an investor. He funds operations that stay invisible and rewards those who understand discretion. He wants proof you can move valuable equipment without drawing attention. Deliver the electronics to the old bunker on Woods. No fighting. No chaos. Just business. If he is satisfied, you may earn an introduction.
699a80908991ef784965077b successMessageT: Efficient. Clean. Exactly what he wanted to see. I passed your name along. Tony agreed to meet you. Do not make me regret the recommendation.
699a80908991ef784965077b startedMessageT: The bunker is isolated and forgotten. Perfect for quiet work. Leave the equipment intact and unseen. This is not about profit. It is about trust.
699a80908991ef784965077b completePlayerM: Everything is in place. Quiet job. No witnesses.
699a80908991ef784965077b failMessageText: You were told to keep things quiet. Violence attracts attention, and attention ruins business. The introduction is off the table.

69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa description: Tony… yeah, I know the type. Keeps his real business buried deep and lets people die without ever knowing who was listening. That usually means he’s sitting on something valuable — or something he really doesn’t want found. I don’t need everything he’s got. Just the right records. Something clean I can read, trace… and use. You bring me that, and you’re not just selling data — you’re handing me leverage.
69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa startedMessageT: I want it clean, readable, and worth my time. Put it together and bring it to me.
69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa successMessageT: Good… this is exactly what I was looking for. Enough to make the right people nervous. That means it’s worth something.
